arguments.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: one isolated full-body LILIPUTS.BMP game sprite. No hammer, stake, lasso loop or pole. Same worker identity: black cap, dark brown hair, tan skin, green long-sleeve shirt, royal blue bib overalls with simple gold buttons, dark charcoal shoes, crisp black outlines and restrained cel shading. Keep the frame-specific pose and head direction described above. Trace each arm from its shoulder through elbow to hand, and each leg from hip through knee to shoe, with natural joints and source occlusions. Do not duplicate a sleeve or add a third limb. Rope where present is flexible warm golden-yellow/tan cord with a thin dark contour, no glow; preserve its path and grip contacts. Keep all original props and entire figure safely inside the canvas with clear margins. Genuine RGBA transparent background, no scenery, floor plane, shadow, halo, text or extra props.
